Codex REJECT rebuttals are not independently closed: alpha NW/liquidity/AX-007, risk CVaR unit/TDC/R2, and optimizer turnover/CVaR deferrals remain active even though the judge mostly relies on fabrication as the sole critical block.

AX-008 triangulation should be FAIL, not partial: Forge source is compromised by frequency fabrication, Architect is absent, and only five phase Codex critique artifacts are present rather than the role prompt's full critique set.
